tests.name: RFDC native格式
tests.acceptance: 不同I/Q计数序列验证所有端口/lane；真实8word和8complex不混淆

tests.name: D8数据对应
tests.acceptance: 145tap量化golden全样点一致、输入输出数和phase一致

tests.name: FIR带宽
tests.acceptance: 通带/阻带/ENBW及边沿误差，与量化模型和工具输出一致

tests.name: 前抽取过载
tests.acceptance: 被抽掉的lane发生clip仍有quality事件

tests.name: 多通道有效性
tests.acceptance: 任一通道掉valid或slip，不产生伪相参整组数据

tests.name: GSC
tests.acceptance: DMA背压不停止计数；epoch/reset/PPS质量正确

tests.name: CSR协议
tests.acceptance: AW/W独立顺序、WSTRB、背压、非法地址和W1C

tests.name: 原子commit
tests.acceptance: 正在capture/replay不得半表或半参数更新

tests.name: 全档INVALID
tests.acceptance: 所有档饱和时拒收/不TX，不默认LOW有效

tests.name: 后沿过载
tests.acceptance: 最后native过载经latency对齐归入同pulse

tests.name: 噪声/检测
tests.acceptance: 纯噪声、低SNR、长脉冲、阶跃和hang状态

tests.name: 预触发
tests.acceptance: ARMING需预填；不能瞬间复制125样点假实现

tests.name: bank wrap
tests.acceptance: 任意起点、跨尾和奇数样点DMA重排正确

tests.name: bank引用
tests.acceptance: DMA/replay先后完成与stale generation ACK

tests.name: RAM冲突
tests.acceptance: 无live写与B口读同地址；读延迟固定

tests.name: 缓存满
tests.acceptance: drop新帧有事件，不覆盖旧RAW

tests.name: 零DMA服务
tests.acceptance: 回放时刻不变化；可因bank满拒绝后续capture

tests.name: TLAST/TKEEP
tests.acceptance: 奇数sample长度及CRC尾，TREADY低时全部stable

tests.name: DMA长度
tests.acceptance: 65664/65680byte大帧不受14/16bit长度截断

tests.name: SG连接
tests.acceptance: BD读写与S2MM均可达DDR、地址>4GB按实际mask

tests.name: CRC/host解码
tests.acceptance: 已知记录逐byte一致、故障注入可识别

tests.name: 命令因果
tests.acceptance: data_ready之后才可用，短目标延迟拒绝

tests.name: 目标距离差
tests.acceptance: 扣实际两程及固定pipeline，不能用2Rv/c直接延迟

tests.name: 超PRI调度
tests.acceptance: 可用slot接受、冲突拒绝，考虑周期/队列

tests.name: TX真实状态
tests.acceptance: planned不等actual；BLOCKED/INTERRUPTED/TRUNCATED正确

tests.name: 分数延迟
tests.acceptance: 全fraction和1/5/10/20MHz误差符合已批准预算

tests.name: DDS
tests.acceptance: 频率、相位、PW/PRI/count、LFM步进及包络延迟

tests.name: AWG
tests.acceptance: inactive装载、CRC、边界切换、不受PS写抖动

tests.name: 源切换
tests.acceptance: 只安全边界；所有源经过同一TXCAL

tests.name: TX插值
tests.acceptance: 1入8出连续、DC/单音增益正确、图像抑制达标

tests.name: DAC静音
tests.acceptance: TVALID无效不被当mute；idle真实零码

tests.name: RF interlock
tests.acceptance: PA/TR先后与tail/guard，故障无法被软件绕过

tests.name: 断钟安全
tests.acceptance: 停止采样clock时实际RF仍能关断或硬件默认安全

tests.name: 多时钟reset
tests.acceptance: SmartConnect协调reset、FIFO busy、reset期间AXI事务

tests.name: MTS
tests.acceptance: 重复启动下规定ADC/DAC相对时延；记录target latency

tests.name: RX/TX校准
tests.acceptance: 不同档位scale、温度/频率适用域和不双补偿

tests.name: 系数pin
tests.acceptance: 延迟队列仍引用旧系数时不能覆盖，或显式drain

tests.name: PDW事件
tests.acceptance: 512bit快照不撕裂、POP/IRQ/overflow语义

tests.name: Linux缓存
tests.acceptance: kernel/user/DMA所有权正确，数据非陈旧cache

tests.name: Linux负载
tests.acceptance: 并发存储/网络/CPU压力，报告有效吞吐和丢失

tests.name: 捕获不等上传
tests.acceptance: CAPTURED/READER_DONE/BD_DONE/HOST_VALIDATED严格区分

tests.name: 三档诊断
tests.acceptance: 一个DMA上3个子帧关联正确，不要求3DMA

tests.name: 时序与资源
tests.acceptance: 真实WNS>=0、TNS=0、严重DRC/CDC=0，无隐匿例外

tests.name: 版本复现
tests.acceptance: 同合同/IP/BSP构建工件与日志可追溯；不能无声IP升级

tests.name: B/C边界
tests.acceptance: host未知参考分析不访问真值，不直接改变当前PL任务

tests.name: 端到端MVP
tests.acceptance: 输入发生器→ADC→DMA；DDS→DAC；cable loopback；LIVE；buffered replay
